name: Status Communities
description: Status App channel plugin — send and receive messages in Status communities via Waku protocol. Supports community management, message history, and member operations.

backendUrl.description: URL of the running status-backend process

keyUID.description: Status account key UID for re-login (obtained after first CreateAccountAndLogin)

dataDir.description: Directory for status-backend data (keystore, DB, wallet)

displayName.description: Display name for the Status account (used on first account creation only)
